_meta.lookup: Keys are shop names exactly as purchase and sale lines print them (shopName[<name>]); a name with a "-<digits>" ending can also be looked up without it. `place` is set only when the game puts that name at exactly one place; a name shared by several places (one shop template used across a chain) has `place` null and lists them in `places`: take the place from the last inventory location the log printed before the line. `kind`: commodity terminal, item shop, refinery, rental, landing services or other, from the inventory type the game gives the shop (`inventory`: COMMODITY or ITEM) and the rules in shops.hand.json. `name` is a display name: a rule in shops.hand.json, else a shop franchise name from the game, else the name in words.
